extracted.name: Onion Pasta
extracted.description: A generous mound of thinly sliced onions, cooked in butter and olive oil, becomes a fragrant, caramelized sauce with the addition of bouillon, water and a pinch of basil. Toss with cooked pasta and sprinkle with Parmesan before serving.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound uncooked pasta, cooked according to package directions
instruction_lines: In a large skillet place oil, butter and onions and cook until golden brown.
Add basil, pepper, water and bouillon and cook on low heat for 10 minutes.
Add onion mixture to cooked pasta, sprinkle with cheese, toss and serve.
